tooltips.start_migration: Run one coordinated migration: every checked component on both the Core (Phase 1) and Modules (Phase 2) tabs, in the tool's built-in dependency order (not the order tabs were opened). Unchecked items are skipped. Browse & Select lists still apply where used.
tooltips.export_to_file: Write the current export manifest and selected component data to disk (for backup, CLI import, or moving to another environment).
tooltips.import_from_file: Import a previously exported bundle from disk onto the connected target (respects export manifest and order).
tooltips.mark_checklist: After you finish migrating this module, mark its checklist section complete so you can track progress.
tooltips.view_log: Open the live migration log in a separate window (resize or copy text as needed).
tooltips.connect_server: Test this server with the URL and credentials above (source: read access; target: write access).
tooltips.disconnect_side: Clear the connection status for this side only; the URL and credentials remain in the form.
tooltips.clear_recent_servers: Remove all entries from this side's recent-servers list (not the current URL field).
tooltips.enable_debug: Choose a log file; detailed debug output is written there for this session (troubleshooting).
tooltips.swap_source_target: Swap source and target connection fields (URL, auth, recent pick, throttling) in one step.
tooltips.open_checklist: Open the migration checklist window to track phases and components.
tooltips.diff_compare: Compare configuration between source and target (see product documentation for scope).
tooltips.export_cli_config: Save a JSON description of enabled components for headless or CLI sync.
tooltips.verify_tls: Validate TLS certificate trust for both servers without running a migration.
tooltips.auto_skip_duplicates: When enabled, duplicates on the target are skipped automatically instead of prompting.
tooltips.api_throttle: Add a short delay between API calls (often helpful on Tanium Cloud / TitanKube rate limits).
tooltips.add_name_rule: Add another regex pattern/replacement row for renaming objects during migration.
tooltips.browse_select: Pick specific source items when the checkbox is enabled (optional selective migration).
tooltips.select_csv: Choose a CSV file; use the document icon for a sample template where offered.
tooltips.csv_sample: Generate or reveal a sample CSV you can edit and use with Select CSV File.
tooltips.browse_platform_users: Choose source Tanium users whose content sets, computer groups, user groups, and personas on the target should match the source (users must already exist on the target).
tooltips.export_select_all_components: Checks every exportable category on the Core (Phase 1) and Modules (Phase 2) tabs in one step, so you can run a full export without touching those checkboxes first. You can also leave this off and enable only the components you need. Browse & Select lists are not changed; when a list is empty, export still includes all items in that category.
tooltips.module_tab: Open "{{module}}" on this tab — components, checkboxes, and Browse & Select for that module.
